fs.hero.unter: What the terraces think, how full the stadium is and what tickets cost.
fs.leer: No home game yet this season: mood, banners and attendance appear after the first match.
fs.preise.hinweis: Areas, seats, occupancy and prices are an estimate from stadium level, reputation and fan mood, not the game's figures. Matchday income goes into the club account; part of the surplus ends up in the transfer budget.
fs.preise.gespeichert: Prices saved: they apply from the next home game.
fs.preise.gesperrt: The club world is not set up yet: prices can be set after the first day.
fs.bereich.vip.fest: Price fixed in the VIP package
fs.empf.halten: Fine as it is: you would not get more here without upsetting the fans.
fs.empf.rauf: Dearer works: more income, and the fans still go along.
fs.empf.runter: Cheaper pays off: more fans and a better mood in the stands.
fs.empf.laune: Cheaper is better for the mood, even if it costs some money.
fs.kurve.unter: One dot per game; home games filled, away games hollow.
fs.kurve.leer: The curve starts with the first competitive game.
fs.banner.unter: What the fans most recently brought to the stands.
fs.heim.geschaetzt: Attendance estimated from fan mood, opponent, form and weather.
fs.naechstes.faktor.stimmung.hoch: The fans are in a good mood
fs.naechstes.faktor.stimmung.tief: The fans are out of sorts
fs.stimmen.leer: Quiet for now: fans speak up after games, transfers and table moves.

fs.post.niederlage.kritisch: {ergebnis} against {gegner}. No ideas and no courage.

fs.post.neuzugang.alt: {name} arrives. Let's see if he fights through.
fs.post.neuzugang.kritisch: {name}, and for that much money? He has to show it first.
fs.post.abgang.kritisch: {name} gone and no replacement yet. This will be expensive.
fs.post.tabelle_oben.alt: Position {platz}. Not this high for a long time.
fs.post.tabelle_oben.kritisch: Position {platz}, good. Don't let up now.
fs.post.tabelle_mitte.alt: Position {platz}, mid-table. We all know more is possible.
fs.post.tabelle_mitte.jung: Position {platz}, still all to play for!
fs.post.tabelle_unten.ultra: Position {platz}. All the more, we won't leave you alone!
fs.post.tabelle_unten.jung: Position {platz} … I'm not looking at the table 🙈
fs.post.tabelle_unten.kritisch: Position {platz}. Who takes responsibility at last?

fs.post.vertrag.alt: {name}'s contract is running out. Players like that you don't let go.
fs.post.vertrag.kritisch: Why is {name} not extended yet? Late again.

fs.post.naechstes.alt: On {tag} against {gegner}. Seat for thirty years, I'm back.

fs.post.derby_naechstes.alt: Derby against {gegner}. My favourite fixture every year.
